tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Papier by day, Nuit for event pages, posters and the hero.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised panels and the inside of a Cadre.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Quiet bands (Crème by day).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and the nest logo on ground — 16.1:1 both themes.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text — 8.3:1 on Papier, 10.4:1 on Nuit.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Captions only — 5.4:1 on Papier, 6.8:1 on Nuit.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders and essential dividers — 3.5:1 on Papier, 4.6:1 on Nuit.

tokens.name: noyer
tokens.usage: Walnut: the Cadre's double filet and inlay hairlines. Decorative, ≥3:1 on its ground.

tokens.name: ambre
tokens.usage: Amber = gold leaf / light wood. The accent ON NUIT only (7.5:1). On Papier it is 2.2:1: never text or logo there; small inlay pieces only.

tokens.name: prune
tokens.usage: Red-dyed wood. Accent on Papier (9.2:1): links, Médaillon bullets, Bande squares.

tokens.name: nacre
tokens.usage: Mother-of-pearl: the light pieces of a Bande and the Cadre's corner on dark.

styles.usage: One per page, the hero line.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Du vrai matériel, des projets réels, une équipe payée correctement.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels; amber on Nuit, prune on Papier.
